SAIL.rig: masthead sloop with an inner forestay · deck-stepped mast through the saloon roof · three swept spreader sets, discontinuous diagonals · twin backstays · roller-furling genoa · self-tacking furling staysail · Park-Avenue boom with a rigid hydraulic vang (no topping lift)

mast.through: saloon (a post from the saloon sole in the cabin view)

boom.kind: Park Avenue — the main flakes into the trough; opts.cover is the boom cover
boom.vang: rigid strut, mast foot +0.55 -> boom at 27% of its length
boom.end_over: the aft deck above the traveller

main.hoist: opts.hoist 0..1 — luff = P*hoist up the mast; the flaked pile nested inside the boom grows 0.08 -> 0.52 m as the cloth comes down
main.stored: hoist 0 + cover:true — the boom cover zipped; the STORED state
main.sheet: opts.main 0..1 — 1 hardened (boom 4°, traveller car centred), 0 eased (boom 86°, car at the leeward track end)

jib.furl: opts.furl 0..1 — rolled onto the forestay; rolled radius 0.05+0.13*furl, the UV strip is the canvas slot

staysail.sheet: self-tacking: angle = min(jib angle, 55°); the car rides the curved track at y 6.35 to x = ±1.472 at full travel
staysail.shadow: fill *0.6 while the genoa is set (furl < 0.6)

pose_law.inputs: awa (deg, + = wind over the starboard bow), aws (kn), main 0..1, jib 0..1, hoist/furl/sfurl 0..1, frame 0..7
pose_law.luff: clamp((8-aoa)/8) — flogging near the luff; |awa|<25 = in irons, every sail flogs whole and the boom wanders ±2°
pose_law.stall: aoa>40 — full but dead; camber eases 40% by aoa 80
pose_law.heel_deg: min(20, 0.04*aws^2*drive*k(awa)) to leeward; drive=0.52*deployed_main*(0.25+0.75*fill_main)+0.48*deployed_jib*(0.25+0.75*fill_jib)+0.18*deployed_staysail*(0.25+0.75*fill_stay); deployed_main=hoist when hoist>0.02, otherwise 0; deployed_jib=1-furl when furl<0.97, otherwise 0; deployed_staysail=1-sfurl when sfurl<0.97, otherwise 0; k=1 to 100°, 0.35 dead downwind; 15% in irons; no canvas gives zero heel
pose_law.frames: 8, looping: cloth flutter + winch handle + (rock:true) the wave
pose_law.note: ART-SIDE law: it makes the sprite agree with itself. Gameplay owns the polar and drive; feed the rig the awa/aws/sheet it decides and the picture follows.

WATERLINE.clip_rule: the water shader cuts at hull z=1.35 — the boot-top BOTTOM. The pivot row is the canoe-body bottom, 1.35 m (~33 px at elev 40) below it; there is no per-facing correction, the DWL is a horizontal line in sprite space under roll 0.
WATERLINE.underbody: fin keel (root chord 4.4 at y -1.0..3.4, bulb at z -2.85) and spade rudder (stock y -11.2) bake only with opts.underbody — the dry reference. Afloat they are under the shader’s water. The swim platform sits 0.2 m above the cut.
WATERLINE.note: Heel is a render param (pose.heel, degrees about the origin): the waterline on the sprite tilts with it; the shader cut stays level in world.

_excluded.LADDER: None — stairs everywhere: the transom stair, the walkway step, the companionway tread, the saloon steps. The swim ladder folds out of the platform and is not modelled.
_excluded.owners_cabin: The aft (owner’s) cabin under the cockpit and aft deck is not cut open in pass 1 — the cockpit and aft deck keep their soles in the cabin view.
_excluded.tender: A secured RIB is visible by default; opts.tender:false exposes the empty well. Launch animation and outboard are not modelled.
_excluded.bimini_sprayhood: Not modelled — the reference deck is clean.
_excluded.spinnaker_code_zero: No downwind sail. The genoa and staysail are blanketed dead downwind (fill *0.4) and that is the picture.
_excluded.wake_spray: The game’s water owns the cut, the wake and the heel-line foam.
